market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Hot jobs report and diesel spike drive Fed hike repricing, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. Inflation report next week is critical catalyst. Expect volatility 8-12% annualized. Energy outperforms; tech selective. Bitcoin likely to test lower support.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI revenue inflection (Salesforce, Oracle) validates 2026-27 earnings cycle. Energy supply constraints support commodity prices through 2027. EM strength and Dangote-type IPOs signal global capital rotation. Key risk: prolonged energy shock triggering stagflation. Fed likely to pause after 1-2 hikes, supporting risk assets by Q1 2027.
